mapper.select: SELECT ROWNUM no, c.* FROM (SELECT * FROM customer ORDER BY id DESC) c
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer(writer, product, usagePeriod, webHosting, hostingType, serverScale, webStorage) VALUES (#{writer }, #{product }, #{usagePeriod }, #{webHosting, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{hostingType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{serverScale, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{webStorage, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET product=#{product}, usagePeriod=#{usagePeriod}, webHosting=#{webHosting, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, hostingType=#{hostingType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, serverScale=#{serverScale, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, webStorage=#{webStorage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id=#{id}
